newsitem.title: UK: PRESS DIGEST - London-based Arab newspapers - Feb 23.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - London-based Arab newspapers - Feb 23.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in two London-based Arabic-language newspapers on Sunday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Qatari emir to open Ras Laffan and Qatargas plants on Monday.
- Yemen signs oil drilling memorandum of understanding with a Hungarian firm.
- National Commercial Bank posts 915 million riyals net profit in 1996.
- Aramco plans new projects worth 13.5 billion riyals until the year 2000. They include new oil pipelines and developing of oilfields.
